rc.text: C · Standalone · inherits the commitments, not the palette

key.text: Rows are lineage. Columns are register: 1 systems and status, 2 print and catalog, 3 schematic and stack. Every tile carries the same content so the systems can be compared: lockup, headline, one real skill card, two actions, palette and type roles. All text pairs shown were measured at 4.5:1 or better. Marks are original sketches; none reuses the SC_ or PF geometry.

ta1.text: Deeper · A1 Rack · after the originality audit

na1.text:
A1 after the audit, what changed:

• Left-stripe skill card became a rack unit with ears, a slot number and a lamp.
• The decorative U01 became the fleet: six real hosts with state from the 2026-10-19 deployment record.
• Web buttons became the real command and a link. patstack is a repository and a CLI, not a web app.
• The canon's state set now has meaning: WARNING external owner changed, VETO apply refused on drift, ARCHIVE retired name.
• Scanlines stay on the poster only; documentation is undecorated.
• Kept as justified: violet on ink and acid are canon, not defaults. The tilted block is the lineage cue to SUBCULT, drawn new, not the SC_ mark.

ta3.text: Deeper · A3 Registration · after the originality audit

na3.text:
A3 after the audit, what changed:

• Isometric exploded layers became flat misregistered plates: source tree, plan, installed tree. Registration means the hashes, modes and symlink targets agree.
• The full violet reading ground became a violet field with a paper sheet. Documentation reads on paper; violet frames it.
• Web buttons became real commands set as ink plates.
• Acid crosshairs are decorative; ink crosshairs carry the motif at small sizes.
• States are filled squares with ink labels. Orange never carries text on paper.
• Risk kept in view: this is the closest to the SUBCULT C parent. The misregistration motif and the sheet-on-field layout are what separate it.
